questions.prompt: Which approach best applies managed heap, garbage collection, and native memory?
options: Separate reachability, allocation rate, managed heap, native or graphics memory, and process footprint before assigning cause.
questions.answer: Separate reachability, allocation rate, managed heap, native or graphics memory, and process footprint before assigning cause.

questions.prompt: An object that remains reachable after GC is necessarily still useful to the application.

questions.prompt: Why can a JNI global reference cause a managed leak?
